title: An engine from an idea
goal: An idea you float becomes an engine: Adaptation shapes it, Priority prices it, Identity puts it to you, and on your stamp the engine joins the line.
ends_when: The engine is on the record and the line, has filed its first version, and you have been told.

steps.text: You float an idea ("keep a list of our events and put the next one on the home page").
Identity recognises new-idea and posts it to Adaptation.
Adaptation hears (code), shapes (model): the idea reflected back; a Library engine picked if its use case fits, else an engine shaped with a name, what it does, what it needs.
Adaptation parks the idea and offers the engine to Priority.
Priority reads, bargains, posts: accept or reject, from what it does, needs and costs.
Priced, Identity puts it to you: "Add the engine X to Y? What it does: … Stamp to add it, Refuse to leave the idea parked."
While the ask is pending every work engine waits; you are told once.

You stamp. The engine and its artifact go on the record with an envelope and a window; Coordination's line grows (before Plan when it reads the Brief); a shaped engine's template is born into the record home's Library with made_by, and web tools when it named a need.
steps.site_code: identity_apply kind engine, W.add_engine, grow_line, born_template

steps.text: The engine starts on its own trigger, a new Brief: read; need (only when it filed before); make; file. You are told "X v1 is filed." with Open X.
steps.site_code: do.read, do.need, do.make, do.file, _tell word filed

steps.short: What it filed is handed on
steps.text: What it filed is handed to Plan, Write and Audit's judge as what the department's own engines filed.

site.text: You are told; the idea is marked priced: refused and stays parked (adapt_priced).
The idea stays parked; the line goes on.

edges.short: A Library engine's use case fits
edges.trigger: A Library engine's use case fits the idea.

site.text: That template is offered; nothing new is shaped.

edges.trigger: The engine's name is already taken in the Library.
The idea names a need (the internet).

site.text: Its prompt steps get WebSearch and WebFetch; every agent step has them anyway (founder 2026-09-29, NEEDS, MODEL_TOOLS).

edges.short: A later Brief does not ask
edges.trigger: A later Brief does not ask for its work.

site.text: Its need step ends the run ok, "not needed: …", files nothing (may_end).
The card says Missing; the health line says "say its idea again to shape it anew"; it has no trigger; the rest of the line runs (missing_engines).
Not read in the docs set: whether a parked idea is matched before a new shape. Open.
